eventMetadata.context_description: Recent PAGASA outlooks for Metro Manila on May 27 project a maximum of 34°C under partly cloudy skies with a 30% chance of afternoon showers and thunderstorms as southwesterly winds strengthen. This aligns with the transition toward the rainy season, when increased cloud cover and moisture can cap daytime heating near historical May averages of 33–34°C. Traders assigning 39.5% implied probability to 36°C and 31% to 37°C appear to weigh urban heat-island effects, potential breaks in cloud cover, and model variability that could push readings 1–2°C higher before any widespread convection develops. Resolution hinges on official station maxima, with scattered rain timing the key uncertainty.
